text.tspan: Share of people who own a mobile phone, by sex 2025
Individuals with a mobile phone with at least one SIM card that has been used in the last three months.

tspan.tspan: Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2015 and 2024 is shown instead.
